A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

H.264 and HEVC video codecs have similar performance for video streaming, however, HEVC video codec is more suitable for video streaming in a congested environment, while H264 is more suitable for a non-congested environment.
H264/AVCs is a good option for low bitrate and low quality videos and H265/HEVC is a good option when high bit rate and high quality videos are needed.

The main takeaway from our work is that
H.265 is a better codec than H.264/AVC in terms of energy consumption, but the gain in energy consumption is lower than the QoE improvement.
H264/AV is more efficient than H.265 when the network has congestion and the user is in a mobile environment.
